name: Pakistan Maritime Museum
address: Habib Ibrahim Rehmatullah Road, Karachi, Pakistan (official site); OSM places the complex off Karsaz Service Road, KDA Scheme 1 Extension, Gulshan-e-Iqbal District (homepage news items describe it as 'Pakistan Maritime Museum, Karsaz Karachi')
entryConditions: Official visitor guidelines: visitors are not allowed to touch any exhibits/paintings/artifacts; school bags/lunch boxes and any eatables are not allowed inside the museum building; commercial photography and video making is not allowed without official permission; museum recommends a teacher/student ratio of 1:10 for school visits.
familySuitability: Family-friendly per official site: dedicated children's ticket (3–11 years), children's package ticket, kids attractions (jumping castles, trampoline, boat ride) and structured school-visit policy.
description: The Pakistan Maritime Museum is a museum complex in Karachi dedicated to the maritime history of Pakistan and the Pakistan Navy. Its official website lists indoor galleries (Orientation Gallery, Maritime History, Ports & Harbours, Marine Life, Antarctica Expeditions, Quaid Corner, whale skeleton and traditional boats among others) plus outdoor paid attractions including a submarine, an aircraft and boat rides. The museum is open every day, 09:00–22:00 Monday to Friday and 09:00–23:00 on weekends per its visitor guidelines.

name: PAF Museum (Pakistan Air Force Museum)

ticketPrices.label: Students (16 Years age / only for schools up to Matric)

entryConditions: Official 'The Museum' page rules: 'Individuals without family are not permitted to enter'; proper dress code required (wearing of 'Shorts' is not allowed); no littering; no sporting activity within museum premises; do not touch the aircraft, radars and other exhibits; children must not be left unattended; the museum is a completely smoke-free zone; management reserves the right to refuse admission. Homepage notice (fetched 2026-10-30): 'Archives Gallery is closed for renovation'.
accessibility: Official page: 'Wheel chairs are available for disabled persons.' People with disability: free entry.
facilities: Fun land for children with swings and merry-go-rounds
familySuitability: Marked family orientation: children's tickets (3–12 years), a children's 'fun land', and an official rule that individuals without family are not permitted to enter.
description: The Pakistan Air Force Museum in Karachi is an aviation and military-history museum set in a museum park, displaying aircraft, radars and other exhibits. Its official website lists daily opening hours, an admission-fee table and free categories (PAF personnel on Mon/Wed/Sat, senior citizens 60+, people with disabilities). Facilities listed by the museum include a souvenir shop, canteen, children's fun land and an entertainment simulator.

name: National Museum of Pakistan
address: Burns Garden, Dr. Zia-ud-din Ahmed Road, Karachi (per Government of Pakistan Department of Archaeology & Museums heritage-sites page); OSM locates the building on Shahrah-e-Quaid area near Pakistan Secretariat, Saddar Town, 75530
description: The National Museum of Pakistan in Karachi was established on 17 April 1950 in Frere Hall, replacing the defunct Victoria Museum, according to the Government of Pakistan Department of Archaeology & Museums (doam.gov.pk). Its present building near Burns Garden dates from 1970 and houses the country's largest collection of archaeological and historical artefacts. No functioning official website was found; operating details could not be verified from an official source.
notes: Location, name and founding history verified via OSM (node tagged tourism=museum) and the federal government DoAM heritage-sites page. The DoAM page states no opening hours or ticket prices. The museum's official Facebook page (facebook.com/NationalMuseumPK) appeared in search results with the text 'We're open all week from 09AM to 05PM (except Wednesdays)', but the page itself could not be fetched (Facebook serves a login/JS wall), so per the honesty rules hours remain null and this snippet is recorded only here, not as data. Blog/aggregator claims about ticket prices (e.g. PKR 20) were deliberately not used. Photo visually verified: front view of the National Museum building with its distinctive screen facade and forecourt garden.

name: State Bank of Pakistan Museum (SBP Museum)
osmName: State Bank of Pakistan (building; museum not separately mapped in OSM)
address: SBP Museum, State Bank of Pakistan headquarters, I.I Chundrigar Rd, Karachi, 74000 (both strings stated on official sbp.org.pk pages)

ticketPrices.label: General admission (official wording: 'Free, without any charges')

entryConditions: Official FAQ: all guided and self-guided school groups and all adult groups must make advance reservations (first-come, first-served); guided tours by museum-trained Gallery Officers are free with admission but must be scheduled in advance; eating not allowed in the premises of the Museum; parking lot exists but must be requested through email in advance; no street parking. Hours page notes a 1:30 p.m - 2:30 p.m lunch break.
contact: Museum: 021-3311-3051; visit bookings: sbpmuseum.visit@sbp.org.pk; SBP UAN +92-21-111-727-111
accessibility: Official FAQ: the Museum is wheelchair accessible and wheelchairs are available at the Museum; tours for visitors with visual or hearing impairments are not yet offered ('it is in planning phase').
facilities: History of State Bank of Pakistan gallery
familySuitability: Suited to school and family group visits per official FAQ (school groups, guided tours by Gallery Officers); free entry. No dedicated children's programming was stated on the fetched pages.
description: The SBP Museum is Pakistan's first money museum, housed in the historic State Bank of Pakistan headquarters building (built 1932 per OSM; 'old SBP Building' per the museum's own text) on I.I Chundrigar Road, Karachi. Its stated rationale is to preserve the monetary heritage of Pakistan and present galleries on the history of the State Bank, coins, stamps, currency and art. Entry is free, it is open Monday to Saturday 9:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m., and guided tours must be booked in advance.

entryConditions: Official passes page: tickets can be bought one at a time or up to 9 tickets at a time, for a visit up to 14 days before the visit date; pass type determines floor access (Limited passes exclude the third floor, science shows and food services; Full passes include all floors and the science garden). Separate phone lines exist for birthday bookings, school visit bookings and MSC Travels bookings.

facilities: Multi-floor interactive exhibition (ground floor plus upper floors including a third floor)
familySuitability: Explicitly family-oriented per official site: a child-based Ground Floor Pass with one accompanying adult free, birthday-party bookings, dedicated school-visit bookings and family annual passes for 2–6 members.
description: The TDF MagnifiScience Centre, set up by The Dawood Foundation, is described on its official website as 'Pakistan's First Interactive Science Centre/Museum'. It is located at Plot no 1 RY-15, Railway Quarter, Karachi, near Karachi City Railway Station, and its official site lists weekday and weekend timings with Friday closed. Admission is via tiered passes (ground-floor, limited-building and full-building) priced in PKR on the official passes page.
notes: OSM node (8633769213, tourism=museum, website=magnifiscience.org) matches the official contact address 'Plot no 1 RY – 15 Railway Quarter' and the geotag embedded in the Commons photo (24.8468, 67.002647). The homepage 'Timings' block (Mon–Thu 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Friday Closed, Sat–Sun 10:00 AM – 7:30 PM) is reproduced exactly; the passes page itself states no per-day timings. Prices carry no effective-date statement on the page. Accessibility is not mentioned on the fetched official pages, so it is null.
